rights: 公開官圖非CC保證，原圖/摺頁私人不公開貼圖；不保證商用權利清理

approved_mapping.part: four existing roof shells of two pavilions
approved_mapping.color: muted orange-brown/terracotta tile family; darker ridge accents only if existing separable component
approved_mapping.limit: Same roof-material family generalization across both pavilions, explicitly not each slope photographed. Under-eave dark muted brown, not green roof. Existing coarse ridges/ornaments not painted multicolor fantasies.

approved_mapping.part: near pavilion y−29 negative-Y front original columns and framing
approved_mapping.color: muted red columns/frame with dark recesses
approved_mapping.limit: Near source includes pale lower column portions; if original cylinder triangle crosses pale/red division, keep full component conservative neutral rather than fake diagonal stripes or new cut.

approved_mapping.color: pale muted gray for visible leaf family; dark for actual deep opening shade
approved_mapping.limit: Source panes/painted decorations not reproduced; cannot paint whole wall white or claim each original blind recess is exact door.

approved_mapping.part: front stairs/high platform and original stele relief
approved_mapping.limit: No new text/mottling, not arbitrary brick-red entire retaining base.

approved_mapping.part: existing front railing panels vs posts
approved_mapping.color: posts/caps pale stone; greenish infill only if complete original panel domain identifiable
approved_mapping.limit: Original solid coarse parapet not fine perforated lattice. Do not invent green holes or treat whole parapet/post assembly as green.

approved_mapping.part: far pavilion walls, unidentified sides/back and terrace horizontal field
approved_mapping.limit: Do not infer mirrored red/white from near front or bare brick from unidentified overview.

mandatory_limits: 雙閣瓦皮同材色族連續是明示概化，不稱每坡逐照證實。
僅近前右階相連前閣皮有對位；遠照裸磚不能任套後閣，其他牆中性。
柱下白/上紅若原三角跨界整柱中性，不切新面或畫斜楔。
原粗實欄非穿孔花欄，綠只可完整識別面，不新增彩繪/題字。
日期/色值未校準，非今日全園區實測，不保證商用權利/實體多色列印。
source_issued_QA_pending: Historical source issue preceded model; final model QA is separate COLOR-FORMAT-GEOMETRY-QA, SCENE-QA, DELIVERY-QA and SOURCE-VISUAL-QA.
